uncited: **Steps**: Sample a point p uniformly from the bounding box B: p ~ U[B].
For each p, sample nv directions vi uniformly from the unit sphere S^2: V(p) = {vi(p) ~ U[S^2]}_{i=1}^{nv}.
Compose these directions to estimate the best direction vb*(p) (as in §V-A2 and §V-A3, but without optimization) to avoid visibility ξ(p, v) = 0.
Compute the surface point q(p, vb*(p)) using the PDDF depth and direction.
The condition for q being on S is ξ(p, v) = 1 and q(p, v) = p + d(p, v)v.
**Parameters**: nv: Number of directions sampled per point.
*   **Time Complexity**: Depends on the number of rays and steps in sphere tracing.
*   **Memory Complexity**: Low for sphere tracing (only storing points).
